steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In April 2022, a guest on Equity Mates referred to Wesfarmers as the quintessential example of brilliant retailers in Australia during a discussion about leading retail operators.

episode.title: Expert: John Sevior - Airlie Funds Management

views.text: In March 2022, Equity Mates described Wesfarmers as home to two of Australia’s best retail businesses, Bunnings and Kmart, and noted it was managing varied supply chain pressures across its retailers.

episode.title: Breaking down the supply chain - Apple, Maersk, Home Depot & more| Quartr Reporting Season

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In April 2022, a guest on Equity Mates said Wesfarmers had enduring business quality that compounded for investors and noted management’s push to improve shareholder returns refreshed its advantages.

episode.title: Expert: John Sevior - Airlie Funds Management

views.text: In March 2022, Equity Mates highlighted comments from Wesfarmers that it managed for the long term, focusing on growing margin dollars and everyday low prices rather than defending short term margin percentages.

episode.title: Breaking down the supply chain - Apple, Maersk, Home Depot & more| Quartr Reporting Season

views.text: In February 2022, Equity Mates said Wesfarmers’ conglomerate model protected earnings in volatile times, with Bunnings and chemicals offsetting weakness in Kmart and Target, showing resilience across cycles.

episode.title: Is that the sound of a SuperBubble bursting?

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?

views.text: In April 2022, a guest on Equity Mates cited Wesfarmers’ acquisition of API as evidence corporates saw value at cyclical lows and expected Wesfarmers to act rationally to improve the pharmacy sector’s structure.

episode.title: Talking Money To Us | Philip Pepe

views.text: In December 2021, Equity Mates covered Wesfarmers’ bid for Australian Pharmaceutical Industries at $1.55 per share and noted it already held a 19.3% stake, showing an expansion move into pharmacy retail.

episode.title: Ren makes a (not so) bold prediction & Speccy returns

views.text: In June 2021, Equity Mates reviewed the 2018 Coles demerger and noted Wesfarmers had risen about 76% since, illustrating portfolio reshaping and capital allocation driving shareholder returns.

episode.title: Woolworths Is Demerging: What Does It Mean?

steps.q: Can it be bought at a reasonable price?

views.text: In October 2026, a guest on Equity Mates noted Wesfarmers had done very well while retail was struggling at the time and floated taking some profits, implying strong performance may have been priced in.

episode.title: RBA raises rates again, Pimp my Portfolio with Henry Jennings & we review the community portfolio

views.text: In March 2018, Equity Mates explained that despite Wesfarmers’ 1H18 profit falling 86.6%, the share price rose on the day, showing how expectations and one‑offs can drive valuation moves more than headline numbers.

episode.title: EM Talk: Learn To Invest In 15 Minutes Or Less
